short: A device that converts analog input signals to digital output.

short: The resistance of a coil for higher-frequency alternating current.
long: The resistance of a coil for higher-frequency alternating current. The value of Re is more than the DC resistance of the coil because it includes the losses associated with high-frequency alternating current in a coil. These losses include skin effect, eddy currents, and hysteresis losses.

short: A circuit as it appears to an AC signal.

long: The equivalent resistance of a forward-biased diode as it appears to small AC signals. For a standard __ diode For the emitter diode in Id IE

short: One that can control voltage or current.
long: One that can control voltage or current. Examples are transistors and diodes.

short: A filter that uses components or devices that have the ability to amplify such as transistors and op amps.
long: A filter that uses components or devices that have the ability to amplify such as transistors and op amps.

long: The region of operation where the collector of a transistor acts like a current source.

long: Air space between poles of a magnet.

long: One that uses alkaline electrolyte.

short: Current that reverses direction at a regular rate.
long: Current that reverses direction at a regular rate. Alternating voltage reverses in polarity. The rate of reversals is the frequency.

long: One-half cycle of revolution of a conductor loop rotating through a magnetic field. This corresponds to one-half cycle of alternating voltage or current.

short: AC generator.
long: AC generator.

long: A meter that can measure AC currents, generally from the 60-Hz AC power line, without breaking open the circuit. The probe of the meter is actually a clamp that fits around the current-carrying conductor. _

short: The basic unit of current.
long: The basic unit of current. 1 A 5 1 C 1 s _ or 1 A 5 1 V 1.

long: A common rating for batteries that indicates how much load current a battery can supply over a specifi ed discharge time. For example, a battery with a 100-A.h rating can deliver 1 A for 100 h or 2 A

long: Unit of magnetizing force equal to 1 A × 1 turn. _

long: A test instrument that is used to make voltage, current, and resistance measurements. An analog multimeter uses a moving pointer and a printed scale to display the value of the measured quantity.

short: A term to describe the condition of unity power factor in a parallel LC circuit.
long: A term to describe the condition of unity power factor in a parallel LC circuit. Antiresonance is used to distinguish it from the case of equal XL and XC values in a series LC circuit.

short: A JFET that has its gate regions offset from the center of the channel.
long: A JFET that has its gate regions offset from the center of the channel. With an asymmetrical JFET the drain and source leads cannot be interchanged.

short: The smallest particle of an element that still has the same characteristics as the element.
long: The smallest particle of an element that still has the same characteristics as the element.

long: The number of protons, balanced by an equal number of electrons, in an atom.

long: The effect that causes a sharp increase in reverse current, IR, when the reverse-bias voltage across a diode becomes excessive.

long: In sine-wave AC voltage or current, 0.637 of peak value.

long: Ohmmeter readings from right to left.

short: A circuit consisting of two series strings in parallel.
long: A circuit consisting of two series strings in parallel. The balanced condition occurs when the voltage ratio in each series string is identical. The output from the bridge is taken between the centers of each series string. When the voltage ratios in each series string are identical, the output voltage is zero and the bridge circuit is said to be balanced.

long: A thin and very lightly doped region in a transistor. The base is sandwiched between the emitter and collector regions.

long: Group of cells connected in series or parallel.

long: Another name for a diac.

long: Steady current from a source used to stabilize output voltage with changes in load current.

long: The region of transistor operation where a large undesired collector current flows as a result of the collector-base diode breaking down due to excessive reverse-bias voltage.
